WITH error_params AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND component IN ('X', 'Y', 'Z', 'AT', 'R')
  AND param_name LIKE '%_ErrorState'
  AND subsystem IN ('110mmStage', '110mmDcMk1')
),

errors AS (
  SELECT v.value_num AS error_code
  FROM data v
  JOIN error_params p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
    AND v.value_num != 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stage_errors
FROM errors

WITH error_params1 AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND component IN ('Sem.X', 'Sem.Y', 'Fib.X', 'Fib.Y', 'SEMX', 'SEMY', 'FIBX', 'FIBY')
    AND param_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%RootError','%_ErrorState'])
    AND subsystem IN ('Apertures', 'AvaFib', 'AvaSem')
),
errors1 AS (
  SELECT v.value_num AS error_code
  FROM data v
  JOIN error_params1 p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
    AND v.value_num != 0
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS aperture_errors
FROM errors1

WITH matching_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, component, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND component IN ('X', 'Y', 'Z', 'AT', 'R')
  AND param_name LIKE '%_ErrorState'
  AND subsystem IN ('110mmStage', '110mmDcMk1')
),

errors AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    p.component,
    d.value_num AS error_code,
    p.enum_id
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_params p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND d.value_num != 0
)

SELECT
  e.time AS "Time",
  'Stage.' || e.component AS "Component",
  en.member_name AS "Error"
FROM errors e
LEFT JOIN enum_values en
 ON en.enum_id = e.enum_id
 AND en.value = e.error_code
ORDER BY e.time DESC;

WITH matching_params1 AS (
  SELECT param_id, component, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component IN ('Sem.X', 'Sem.Y', 'Fib.X', 'Fib.Y', 'SEMX', 'SEMY', 'FIBX', 'FIBY')
    AND param_name LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%RootError','%_ErrorState'])
    AND subsystem IN ('Apertures', 'AvaFib', 'AvaSem')
),

all_errors AS (
  SELECT
    v.time,
    p.component,
    v.value_num AS error_code,
    p.enum_id
  FROM data v
  JOIN matching_params1 p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE v.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
    AND v.value_num != 0
)

SELECT
  e.time AS "Time",
  'Apertures.' || e.component AS "Component",
  en.member_name AS "Error"
FROM all_errors e
LEFT JOIN enum_values en
  ON en.enum_id = e.enum_id
  AND en.value = e.error_code
ORDER BY e.time DESC

WITH error_params AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND component = 'Safety'
  AND param_name = 'TouchAlarmCountParameter'
  AND subsystem = 'System'
)

SELECT MAX(v.value_num)-MIN(v.value_num) AS stage
FROM data v
JOIN error_params p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND $__timeFilter(v.time)

WITH params AS (
  SELECT subsystem, component, param_name
  FROM (VALUES
    ('Compustage', 'X', 'X.ControlOutput'),
    ('Compustage', 'X', 'X.SettlingDuration'),
    ('Compustage', 'X', 'X.MaxPositionError'),
    ('110mmStage', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_MaxControllerOut'),
    ('110mmStage', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_SettlingTime'),
    ('110mmStage', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_MaxPositionError'),
    ('110mmDcMk1', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_MaxControllerOut'),
    ('110mmDcMk1', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_SettlingTime'),
    ('110mmDcMk1', 'X', 'X_MoveStopped_MaxPositionError')
  ) AS t(subsystem, component, param_name)
),

label_map AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('X.ControlOutput', 'Max Controller Output'),
    ('X_MoveStopped_MaxControllerOut',  'Max Controller Output'),
    ('X.SettlingDuration', 'Settling Duration'),
    ('X_MoveStopped_SettlingTime', 'Settling Duration'),
    ('X.MaxPositionError', 'Max Position Error'),
    ('X_MoveStopped_MaxPositionError', 'Max Position Error')
  ) AS lm(param_name, label)
),

matching_params AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, p.param_name
  FROM parameters p
  JOIN params t
    ON p.component = t.component
   AND p.param_name = t.param_name
   AND p.subsystem = t.subsystem
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument 
),

raw_values AS (
  SELECT
    v.time,
    p.param_name,
    v.value_num
  FROM data v
  JOIN matching_params p ON v.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
),

agg_values AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    MIN(value_num) AS raw_min,
    MAX(value_num) AS raw_max,
    AVG(value_num) AS raw_avg,
    STDDEV(value_num) AS raw_stdev
  FROM raw_values
  GROUP BY param_name
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(lm.label, av.param_name) AS parameter,
  CASE 
    WHEN av.param_name ~* 'Position' THEN
      CASE 
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg   * 1000
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev * 1000
      END
    ELSE
      CASE 
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'min'   THEN av.raw_min
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'max'   THEN av.raw_max
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'avg'   THEN av.raw_avg
        WHEN '$stat_type' = 'stdev' THEN av.raw_stdev
      END
  END AS value
FROM agg_values av
LEFT JOIN label_map lm ON av.param_name = lm.param_name
ORDER BY parameter;
